name: A2 Takeoff Calc
subtitle: Feet-inch calculator & takeoff
promotionalText: A feet-inch-fraction calculator with takeoffs for framing, block, concrete, stairs, flooring and wall tile. Plans, sections and 3D. Free, no ads, no account.
description:
A construction calculator that speaks feet, inches and fractions, with quick takeoffs you can see: a dimensioned floor plan, a wall-by-wall drawing and a 3D view of what you're building.

FEET, INCHES AND FRACTIONS
Type it the way you say it: 5' 3 1/2" + 2' 10 3/4" = 8' 2 1/4". Areas and volumes come out in square feet, square yards, cubic feet or cubic yards. Squares, cubes and roots, parentheses, a tape of everything you worked out, and memory letters A to F. Round to 1/16", 1/8" or whatever you work to.

STUD WALLS
Lay out walls one after another, turning left or right, with doors and windows. Get full-height studs, kings, jacks, headers, cripples, sills and plates, a cut list and what to buy in stock lengths. Drag a window along the wall and watch it reframe.

BLOCK WALLS AND GROUT
Grout for a CMU wall, solid or cells at a spacing, with the cells at corners, wall ends and each side of every door and window. Lintels over openings, either lintel block grouted with the wall or formed and poured, shown as their own concrete. Block count too.

CONCRETE
Slabs, footings, walls, beams, columns and round piers, with waste and pump loss, rounded up to what you order.

STAIRS
Enter the rough rise and the floor finish; get the riser count and height, treads, run and angle to IRC or IBC limits. Landings where the code needs them, straight or turning L or U, a dimensioned stringer for each flight, and the floor opening for headroom.

FLOORING
Tile or plank laid out piece by piece in a rectangle or any square-cornered room with doorways: straight, offset, herringbone, basketweave, hopscotch, hexagon or octagon and dot, square to the walls or turned. Snap chalk lines at the center, a wall or a doorway, or let Best fit find the widest smallest cut. Full and cut pieces, the cut at each wall, boxes, thinset, grout, underlayment, base and transitions.

WALL TILE
One wall at a time, from the floor or the top of a tub up to any height, with windows, niches and doors cut out. Level and plumb lines, edge trim and backer board, an elevation of the layout and sections through the wall.

SEE IT
Every takeoff has a dimensioned drawing (tap a wall to edit it), sections you drag into place and a 3D view you can turn and zoom. Keep the drawing pinned at the top while you change the numbers, or float it in a corner.

CONVERSIONS
Lengths, areas and volumes between imperial and metric.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account, no tracking. Nothing you enter leaves your device. A2 Calc is open source under the MIT license.

Use at your own risk: these are estimates. Check every quantity against the plans and with your supplier before you order or bid.
whatsNew:
New: Flooring and Wall tile takeoffs, and stairs that turn.
- Flooring: tile or plank laid out piece by piece in a rectangle or any square-cornered room with doorways. Straight, offset, herringbone, basketweave, hopscotch, hexagon or octagon and dot, square to the walls or turned.
- Chalk lines from the center, a wall or a doorway, and Best fit for the widest smallest cut. Full and cut pieces, the cut at each wall, boxes, thinset, grout, underlayment, base and transitions.
- Plan, Section and 3D views. Drag a section mark on the plan to slide or turn it; each section shows the floor wall to wall, with both ends at true size.
- Wall tile: one wall at a time, from the floor or a tub up to any height, with windows, niches and doors cut out, level and plumb lines, edge trim and backer board. Elevation and sections through the wall.
- Stairs: a landing can turn, L or U, left or right, with a section for each run.
- Every takeoff keeps its drawing in view: Small or Large at the top, pinned or not, or float it in a corner.
- Pinch to zoom and swiping between drawings work better on iPhone.
reviewNotes:
1. Screen recording: a recording made on a physical iPhone, starting from the home screen and app launch, is attached to our previous submission (version 0.2.12). This update adds the Flooring and Wall tile takeoffs, which work the same way as the others (see 3). The app has no accounts, no sign-in, no user-generated content and no paid content or in-app purchases.

2. Purpose and audience: A2 Calc is a construction calculator for contractors, carpenters, masons, tile setters and estimators in the US. The problem: plans and tape measures use feet, inches and fractions (5' 3 1/2"), which ordinary calculators can't add or multiply. A2 Calc does that math directly, gives areas and volumes in sq ft / cu yd, and includes takeoffs that turn dimensions into material quantities: studs, plates and headers for a framed wall; blocks and grout for a block wall; cubic yards of concrete; risers, treads and stringers for a stair; and, new in this version, tile or plank pieces, boxes, thinset and grout for a floor or a tiled wall. It's free.

3. How to use it: no setup, login or sample files. Open the app:
- Calculator: type 5 ' 3 " 1/2 + 2 ' 10 " 3/4 = (the ' and " keys are feet and inches). Tap a letter A-F after = to store the answer.
- Menu (top right) > Takeoff > Stud wall: tap any dimension to edit it, switch the plan to 3D, and drag a window in the wall drawing.
- Menu > Takeoff > Block fill grout, Concrete and Stairs work the same way.
- Menu > Takeoff > Flooring (new): change the room size and the tile size and pattern; the plan shows every piece. Switch the drawing to Section or 3D; on the plan, drag a section line to move it.
- Menu > Takeoff > Wall tile (new): set the wall length and the tile height, add a window or niche, and see the elevation and the section.
- The buttons under the drawing (Hide, Small, Large, Float, Pin) set how it stays on screen while scrolling.
- Projects: on a takeoff screen tap Save to project. Export makes a PDF report or a CSV file on the device and hands it to the iOS share sheet.

4. External services: none. The app makes no network requests. Everything runs and is stored on the device. No analytics, ads, authentication, payment or AI services.

5. Regional differences: none. The app works the same in all regions. Units are imperial (US construction), with metric conversion in Menu > Convert. Stair limits follow the US model codes (IRC, IBC), and the app reminds users to check their local code.

6. Regulated industry or third-party material: not applicable. A2 Calc is a calculator. It contains no protected third-party content, and its results are estimates the user checks against the plans and the local code.

Contact: support@a2cons.com
